parsed.faithful: ACROTELEUTIC, among ecclesiastical writers, an appellation given to any thing added to the end of a psalm; as the Gloria Patri, or Doxology. ACROTERIA, in architecture, small pedestals, usually without bases, anciently placed at the middle or two extremes of pediments or frontispieces, serving to support the statues, &c. It also signifies the figures placed as ornaments on the tops of churches, and the sharp pinnacles that stand in ranges about flat buildings with rails and ballusters.
